cards.text: Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, once dreamed of a giant statue, and Daniel told him, 'You are that head of gold.' (Daniel 2:38) Now the king makes a statue of his very own. And friend, this thing is TALL.

cards.question: King Nebuchadnezzar makes a ___ statue.
How high is King Nebuchadnezzar's golden statue?

cards.text: He sets it up on the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon. Then he sends for the satraps, prefects, governors, judges, magistrates and every other official in the provinces, basically the WHOLE org chart.

cards.question: Why does Nebuchadnezzar call every official to the plain of Dura?

answers.text: To pay the king's new taxes

cards.text: They all show up and stand before the statue. Then a herald loudly makes an announcement to people of every nation and language.

cards.question: The herald says that as soon as the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp and pipes play, everyone must do what?

answers.text: Fall down and worship the statue
Stand up and sing to the king
Turn around and face the palace

cards.question: The herald says anyone who won't fall down and worship will immediately be thrown into the ___.

cards.text: Then the band kicks in: horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, all kinds of music. That's a WHOLE concert just to tell people to get on the floor.

cards.question: True or false: When the music plays, the people of every nation and language fall down and worship the golden statue.

cards.text: Then some astrologers come forward and maliciously accuse the Jews. They walk the king through his own decree, which is like explaining to your boss the memo your boss wrote.

cards.question: The astrologers say some Jews refuse to serve the king's gods or worship the statue. Who put those Jews in charge of the province of Babylon?

cards.text: Their names are Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, three Jews the king appointed to manage the province of Babylon. Nebuchadnezzar, furious with rage, has them brought in.

cards.question: True or false: The moment Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego are brought in, Nebuchadnezzar has them thrown into the furnace without a word.
Nebuchadnezzar asks Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego if the report is true. Then what does he give them?

answers.text: Another chance to bow when the music plays
A night in prison to think it over
A gift of gold if they bow down

cards.text: He ends with a question: 'Then what god will be able to deliver you from my hands?' I bet he thinks that settles it.

Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego answer the king: 'O Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.' Friend, if my oven timer so much as BEEPS at me, I'm over there explaining myself for twenty minutes.

cards.question: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego answer the king's question. What do they say their God is able to do?

answers.text: Deliver them from the furnace and the king's hand
Make the king forget about his decree
Crush the golden statue into dust

cards.question: True or false: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego say that if God doesn't deliver them, they'll bow to the statue after all.

cards.text: Their words: 'But even if He does not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden statue you have set up.' At this, Nebuchadnezzar is filled with rage, and his face changes toward them.

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar orders the furnace heated ___ times hotter than usual.

cards.text: He has some mighty men of valor from his army tie the three up. In they go, still wearing their robes, trousers and turbans.

cards.question: The king's command is urgent and the furnace is blazing. What happens to the men who carry Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego up?

cards.text: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, firmly bound, fall into the blazing fiery furnace. Now keep your eyes on the king.
Suddenly King Nebuchadnezzar jumps up in amazement and asks his advisers if they threw three bound men into the fire. They tell him, 'Certainly, O king.'

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar looks into the furnace. What does he see?

answers.text: Three men lying still in the flames
The fire dying down to ashes

cards.question: True or false: The men Nebuchadnezzar sees in the fire are still tied up.

cards.text: The king says the fourth 'looks like a son of the gods!' Three went in and FOUR are walking around, and friend, I've miscounted a batch before, but never UP.

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar goes to the furnace door and calls Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego to come out. What does he call them?

answers.text: Servants of the Most High God
Traitors to the king of Babylon

cards.text: So the three walk right out of the fire. The satraps, prefects, governors and royal advisers all crowd around to get a look at them.

cards.question: True or false: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego come out of the furnace smelling like smoke.

cards.text: Not a hair singed, robes untouched, no smell of fire on them at all. Friend, I walk PAST an oven and smell like it all week.

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar says, "Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego." Who does he say that God sent to deliver them?

cards.text: The king even says they risked their lives rather than serve or worship any god except their own God. Then the man who built a sixty cubit statue makes a brand new decree.

cards.question: True or false: Nebuchadnezzar decrees that anyone who says anything offensive against the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego will be cut into pieces.
Then the king ___ Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the province of Babylon.
